domain: Arbitrary noncommutative Ring R, arbitrary index type I, finite List I

obligations.name: DoubleOrientation.cross_list
obligations.statement: y_i*prod(L.map x)=(-1)^length(L)*prod(L.map x)*y_i under the explicit odd relations

obligations.name: DoubleOrientation.pair_square_zero
obligations.statement: forall i, (x_i*y_i)*(x_i*y_i)=0 under the explicit odd relations

obligations.name: DoubleOrientation.pairs_commute
obligations.statement: forall i j, (x_i*y_i)*(x_j*y_j)=(x_j*y_j)*(x_i*y_i) under the explicit odd relations

obligations.name: DoubleOrientation.orientation_factorization
obligations.statement: prod(L.map (fun i => x_i*y_i))=(-1)^(length(L)*(length(L)-1)/2)*prod(L.map x)*prod(L.map y) under the explicit odd relations

scope: Double orientation algebra only; no scalar top-coordinate gate or root complexity assumption.
